additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437557-DC/Si-D/PK-[MULTIPLE] HMI showing error CRM:02832000224
additional_info.body:
Dear Tania,
Siemens eMobility Team – Germany,
I am writing to bring to your urgent attention, a critical and unresolved issue regarding two Siemens Sicharge D 160 kW EV chargers, which are currently non-functional and causing significant operational disruption at our site.
Despite continued and prolonged efforts by Siemens Pakistan—along with intermittent support from the Middle East technical team—the issue remains unresolved for over months, with no clear diagnosis or resolution in sight. This situation is not only impacting our EV charging operations but is seriously undermining confidence in the reliability, aftersales service, and technical competence associated with the Siemens brand.
To elaborate:
First Charger – Serial No. MP/NN170000080 (Installed)
This unit has been facing recurring system errors for the last four months, with the issue now escalating to a complete shutdown. During this extended downtime, we have received inconsistent explanations from the local team, ranging from system software faults to +KF11 relay issues, and potential cable faults. To date, no definitive diagnosis or solution has been offered, which is deeply concerning.
Second Charger – Serial No. MP/N0170000062 (Unused/New Unit in Warehouse)
We requested Siemens Pakistan to replace the above non-functional unit with our second, brand-new unit. However, to our surprise, the new charger also failed to operate and repeatedly reboots without stabilizing. Upon inspection, Siemens Pakistan informed us that the +KF11 relay in the new unit is also faulty. When we requested warranty coverage for this newly unboxed unit—installed just last day—we were informed that the warranty had expired, which is completely unacceptable given the fact that this charger was unused and still packed in our warehouse until very recently.
Impact on Operations and Reputation
We procured these chargers under the impression that Siemens equipment is robust, reliable, and backed by world-class aftersales support. However, after nearly four months of unresolved issues and multiple conflicting diagnoses, we find ourselves at a complete standstill. These chargers are installed at a publicly accessible site with a substantial user base. Their continued downtime is eroding our customer trust and is visibly damaging Siemens' brand image in the local market.
Given the severity of the situation, we urge Siemens eMobility Germany to immediately intervene and take ownership of this case to ensure swift and effective resolution. This matter has escalated beyond local handling, and it is imperative that senior technical experts from Siemens International are involved to restore functionality and restore customer confidence.
We sincerely hope Siemens will stand by its reputation and provide the technical accountability and support expected from a global leader in EV charging solutions.
Your immediate action in this matter is not only expected—it is necessary.
With best regards / Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Ijaz Ahmed
Head Of Engineering
Premier Motors Limited
501, 5th Floor Business Plaza
Mumtaz Hassan Road
74000 Karachi Pakistan

additional_info.body:
Good evening Mr. Ijaz Ahmed,
I hope this message finds you well.
My name is Fosco Servidei, I am a technical expert for Sicharge D within the Service Delivery team. I am reaching out in response to your recent communication regarding the two chargers at your site, referenced under ticket
ID0437557
.
First and foremost, I would like to sincerely apologize for the ongoing issues you are experiencing.
We fully recognize the operational challenges this situation presents and deeply appreciate your patience and understanding. Please rest assured that Siemens is fully committed to resolving this matter. Our HQ team is working in close coordination with our colleagues at Siemens Pakistan to ensure a seamless and effective resolution. This collaboration ensures that all necessary technical expertise and resources are aligned, and that no communication gaps exist between our teams.
Allow me to share a brief technical update on the current status of both chargers:
Charger MP/NN 170000080 (addressed in Ticket ID0419755):
This charger has unfortunately encountered multiple simultaneous issues. As the unit is out of warranty, such cases—while rare—can occur. Our Expert Services team has supported the local Siemens colleagues in identifying the faulty components. The order of the spare parts is required, and the local Siemens team is leading the process in terms of quotation and purchase order. From our headquarters' perspective, we unfortunately do not have direct control over the ordering and delivery of spare parts, as these are subject to customs regulations and shipping inspections.
Charger MP/NN 170000062 (addressed in Ticket ID0438250):
This charger has not yet been commissioned. During setup, a controller was found to have an incorrect IP configuration. The Expert Services team has already provided guidance, and the component requiring replacement has been identified. The local team will manage the replacement process accordingly, as also this charger is currently out of warranty.
We would like to emphasize that your primary point of contact remains the local Siemens Pakistan team. Mr. Adnan Khan and service coordinator for Pakistan Mr. Thangal Basheer are fully informed and equipped to manage the on-site activities and will provide you with a detailed action plan and timeline. Please feel confident that your local Siemens Pakistan team is in continuous and close coordination with our headquarters experts. All necessary information and support are being shared seamlessly, so you may continue communicating with the local team, who are fully empowered to guide and assist you throughout the resolution process.
Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. Your concerns are important to us, and we remain fully committed to supporting our local team in restoring full functionality at your site.
With kind regards and best wishes,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG

13629 Berlin, Germany

Thank you.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437557-DC/Si-D/PK- Charger MP/NN 170000062 (addressed in Ticket ID0438250):
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Fosco,
Good Afternoon !
I hope this message finds you in the best of health and high spirits.
Thank you for your detailed response and continued support regarding the subject issue.
We would like to bring to your attention that Mr. Adnan Khan, representative of Siemens Pakistan, visited our site and physically inspected the charger unit. During his visit, we powered on the new charger in his presence.
While we fully acknowledge that the charger is currently outside of its warranty period, the feedback received from Siemens Pakistan indicates that the root cause of the malfunction stems from an incorrect IP configuration at the factory level. Given that this issue is attributable to a manufacturing/configuration error rather than a site-related or operational fault, we strongly believe that the component in question,
+KF11
, should be replaced free of charge.
We would also like to highlight that we have recently invested in a fully Siemens-certified and type-tested solution (MV & LV systems) for our new Volkswagen CKD assembly plant. Additionally, all our production shops are equipped with Siemens automation and drive solutions—including PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, and motors. Our long-standing trust in Siemens is based on the exceptional reliability of your products and the consistently strong customer support we have received.
In light of this, we kindly request the same level of commitment and support to help us resolve this issue amicably and without any financial burden.
We highly value the continued involvement of Siemens Pakistan and look forward to receiving an updated action plan and timeline for the necessary replacement.
With best regards / Mit freundlichen Grüßen
